 Getty Images Sport Gianluca Minchiotti Oct 27, 2026 15:44-07:00 Translated by Como, Fabregas: “We hit the woodwork twice, had a penalty not given; last year we wouldn’t have won it”
 Torino vs Como Torino Como Serie A C. Fabregas The Spanish manager speaks after the win away at Torino
 Como manager Cesc Fabregas reflects on the 3-1 comeback win away at Torino. 
 "We hit the woodwork twice, were denied a penalty and had plenty of chances, yet we were 1-0 down. It depends how you look at it... I saw a Como side full of desire; last year we wouldn’t have won this match," reports TMW. 
 "We have a high standard in goal too, and we need to rotate because of the number of matches. We’ve never had the same starting eleven, and that puts you at a bit of a disadvantage." 
 "Torino? They embody Abate's values as a player. They are an organised team; when they take the lead, they switch to a 3-5-2 and it becomes difficult."
